rationale: Base rate for a major AAA release date that Rockstar has publicly reconfirmed (Nov 2025 delay announcement, Nov 3 2026 pre-load announcement starting Nov 10) about 12 days before launch is high, though GTA VI has already slipped twice. No newer official date found. Main risk is a late delay; leaks alone do not move it much.

Base rates: NASA's 2024 eclipse stream peaked at 1,458,212 (official), and 2017 was reported at 2-3 million. The 2026 path is mostly outside the US, which the description notes may lower viewership. No official 2026 peak figure was found in search results. Pre-event guide claims of 15 million are unreliable. A YES needs an official figure above 2 million or a YouTube peak above it.

Microsoft Office and Microsoft 365 are mainstream products that are almost certainly still active three days from now. The only real risk is ambiguity in what 'active' means, not a shutdown. No evidence of any shutdown was found.

Anthropic publicly filed an S-1 (Oct 26) and an amendment (Nov 2) and applied for Nasdaq listing as ANT. Reports, including WSJ and Reuters, target the week of Nov 16, with Nov 19-20 and a later Nov 26 date also discussed. The price range is still blank and no date is confirmed. Listing by the close of Nov 20 is plausible but timing risk is large, and sources conflict.

India has publicly said it will not sign any pledge (Nov 3, 2026). The US has left Paris and is not sending an official delegation, so a US government signature is unlikely. No statement on China was found. Only China remains as a possible route, and China's position is unclear; the market's YES route is narrow.

Base rate for any nuclear detonation by a state is very low, and nothing confirmed points to one. The Tucker Carlson claim is unverified, the White House and Rubio deny a decision, Trump has ruled out nuclear options, and experts call it highly unlikely. Conventional strike planning exists (including the MOAB), but that does not qualify.

The Nov 9 ECOFIN is on the agenda with a general approach as the target, but reporting says Sweden has opposed the nicotine pouch minimum tax and unanimity is required. Past attempts were pulled from the agenda. A general approach might not count as a formal confirmation that vapes and pouches become part of the directive. Uncertain, leaning NO.

Same underlying event as the Manifold Anthropic IPO question. Reported target is the week of Nov 16, with Nov 19-20 mentioned. No confirmed date, no price range in the amended S-1, and the timeline may shift. Listing by 11:59 PM ET on Nov 20 is plausible but not established. The timeline is reported only by press.

Several sources say Google launched Gemini 4 Carbon on Oct 28, 2026, before the Nov 9-15 window, with limited access to cyber defenders and trusted partners. Under the criteria, a qualifying release needs general public availability inside the window, and the sources conflict on whether broad public access has happened. Low probability for a window release, with some uncertainty about the source conflict.

Same event as the other GTA VI question. Rockstar has stated Nov 19, 2026, and reaffirmed it with the Nov 10 digital pre-load start and retail boxed copies going out Nov 12. A delay in the last 12 days would be unusual, though GTA VI has slipped twice before.

The blockade was reinstated July 13, and the latest reporting (Nov 7) says the US is expanding it, creating Task Force Iron Gate for land and Caspian routes. Trump claims diplomacy is progressing, but gives no terms, and the resolution needs an official, unambiguous general end. Only a short window (about 8 days) remains, so a YES is unlikely.

As of the latest reporting, T CrB has not erupted. Predicted dates such as June 25, 2026 have passed. The most recent MNRAS analysis (data through July 2026) gives a plausible eruption around December 2026, with wide uncertainty, and it is a monitoring hypothesis. Reaching magnitude 5 before Nov 11 needs an eruption in the next 4 days and a brightening far beyond the historical peaks of about magnitude 2-3. Near-settled NO.
